home.title: Obordeleau, air-conditioned studio at Les Sablettes, 70 m from the beach
home.description: A 3-star studio at Les Sablettes near Toulon. Beach on foot in 2 minutes, shuttle boat to Toulon at the door, no car needed. Book direct.

hero.subtitle: Park the car and forget about it. The sandy beach at Les Sablettes is a two minute walk through the park, the shuttle boat to Toulon leaves from the foot of the building, and the shops and restaurants are all in the neighbourhood.

hosting.body: The site is hosted by Vercel Inc., 340 S Lemon Ave #4133, Walnut, CA 91789, United States. The domain name is managed by Hostinger.

property.title: The property
property.body: Obordeleau is a 3-star classified furnished holiday rental at 253 Av. Jean-Baptiste Mattei, 83500 La Seyne-sur-Mer, France. Local registration number: {declaration}.

intellectual.title: Intellectual property
intellectual.body: The texts and photographs on this site belong to the publisher. Reproduction without permission is not allowed. Guest reviews remain the property of their authors and are reproduced unaltered.

credits.title: Credits
credits.body: Mapping: Google Maps, loaded only after your agreement. Audience measurement: Vercel Web Analytics, without cookies.

principle.title: The principle
principle.body: This site collects the minimum. No personal data travels in page addresses, no advertising cookie is set, and no third party service loads before you explicitly agree.

inquiry.title: Your booking inquiry
inquiry.body: When you send the form, we email the owner the details you entered: name, email address, phone number if you give one, requested dates, number of guests and message. They are used only to reply to you. They are never sold, never used for marketing, and they stay in the owner's mailbox for the length of the exchange, then are deleted at the latest three years after the last contact. The site itself keeps no database.

analytics.title: Audience measurement
analytics.body: We use Vercel Web Analytics, which measures traffic without cookies and without an identifier that would recognise you from one visit to the next. We know how many people saw a page and which booking buttons were clicked, never who you are.

map.title: The map
map.body: The map in the "Where the studio is" section is provided by Google Maps and loads as soon as the page opens. Google therefore receives your IP address and may set cookies under its own rules, without any action from you. If you would rather avoid that, the full address is written out next to the map and you can look it up in the mapping application of your choice.

hosting.title: Hosting and logs
hosting.body: The site is hosted by Vercel, which keeps technical connection logs to run and secure the service. Inquiry emails are sent through Resend, a transactional email service.

reviews.title: Reviews and profile photos
reviews.body: Reviews are shown with the first name only. Profile photos are hosted on this site and are not loaded from a third party.

rights.title: Your rights
rights.body: You can ask for access to, correction of, or deletion of your details by writing to {email}. You can also lodge a complaint with the CNIL, the French data protection authority.

notFound.body: The link may be old or mistyped. You can start again from the home page.
